blocks.text: The inspector signs on the device at the moment of signing, online or not. signed_at is stamped right then.
The PDF prints the signature and the time signed.
Each PDF carries a short check code, so an auditor can confirm the file hasn't changed since it was signed.
A signed inspection is never edited. A correction is a new inspection that points to the old one.
A correction shows on the PDF with a pointer to the inspection it corrects.
The original PDF stays exactly as it was signed. Paris passed on the auditor's question about this today; show one on Friday.
Mercutio: leave a spot for the pointer on the layout.
Was: nightly batch, Balcony to Mesh Routing.
